style.styleTitle: The White Company Set of 4 Christmas Glass Sweets
style.toneOfVoice: Delicate, vintage-inspired set. Handmade from mouth-blown glass. Comes with a velvet ribbon. Style with our candy cane decorations. Our glass sweets are a treat for decorating dining tables or tree branches. Each one is handmade – mouth-blown from glass. They come in three different designs: a frosted glitter look, mercury finish and two with optic ribbing that sparkles under the fairy lights. The sweet-wrapper frill edges really add to the charm of these decorations. This piece is crafted by hand. Variations in design may occur.
